svg.text: His double, made of amber light. It has his hair, his jumper, his face; its eyes are lit and it smiles. No legs: below the hem it is one thread tied to whatever feeds it.
amber typewriter, lowercase, typed on letter by letter next to it
the narrator is the opposite: white, sentence case, at the bottom
• it is the only warm light in any scene: it lights his face
• it never walks; it pays out thread, and goes slack when it loses
• it grows 1 → 4 as it wins; only at 4 does it get his cowlick
• it has the same face: by film's end you can't tell whose line it is
